name: A demoted PassRole path must NEVER hide a co-located higher-severity broad-resource grant (S2-passrole-allstmts, iteration 5)
note: correlate.js folds a same-service WILDCARD-RESOURCE (high) INTO the compound PassRole path as a `subsumed` sub-entry. That is safe only while the compound path is at least as severe as what it swallows. Once the T91/S2 cross-account (or cross-partition) viability check DEMOTES the compound path critical->medium (and an ECS staging path high->low), the subsumed HIGH broad-resource grant drops beneath the 'high' CLI exit gate and the shipped scan()/GitHub Action reports exit 0 CLEAN on a policy carrying a genuine HIGH over-broad-resource grant. The SAME broad grant alone gates at exit 1 (control), proving it is a real HIGH. And because detectPassRolePaths selected the exec statement by lowest INDEX, reordering the byte-content-identical statements swapped which exec the path consumed and flipped exit 0<->1. The fix: (1) a subsumption must never lower the effective gating severity below what it folds away - a subordinate whose severity OUTRANKS the (post-demotion) primary stays an independent top-level row; (2) exec-statement selection prefers the BROADEST resource scope by content, so it is order-invariant. Every enumerated ordering of every case MUST yield exit 1 with the WILDCARD-RESOURCE high row PRESENT at top level and the PassRole path correctly demoted.

cases.label: lambda: cross-account-demoted PassRole + broad vs narrow exec
ecs staging: cross-account-demoted PassRole (high->LOW staging) + broad exec
